title: Retain resources through completion
scope: Implement common command-list/completion ownership for referenced allocations and indirect bindings.
acceptance: Dropping a token or client handle cannot free resources used by pending work.
Submit failure/device teardown drain or cancel safely with mock lifetime tests.
